**Department: QC Stability and Reference Materials

****Location: Bagsvaerd, Denmark

****Your impact begins here

**Are you an engaged laboratory technician with a proactive and can-do attitude? Do you enjoy a working day with tasks in the laboratory as well as in IT systems, helping ensure that the quality of our products lives up to strict standards? Would you like to contribute to improving the lives of people living with diabetes and other chronic diseases worldwide? Then you could be our next Laboratory Technician in QC Stability 2 in Bagsværd.

By the end of 2028, the department expects to relocate together with the QC laboratories to Future QC in Hillerød.

You will join us on a two-year fixed-term contract, with the opportunity to contribute to an evolving area and help shape the way we work with stability activities.

**What You’ll Bring

**To succeed in this role, you have:

• An education as Laboratory Technician (Laborant), Bioanalytiker or equivalent

• Experience working in a GMP environment

• Experience working with IT systems, preferably LIMS

• Experience working with stability studies is an advantage, but not a requirement

• Professional communication skills in Danish and English, both written and spoken

On a personal level, you have a positive can-do attitude and thrive in a fast-paced and changing environment. We expect that you have a problem-solving attitude towards challenges and that you are a team player, ready to jump in and help your colleagues during busy periods, while also being able to work independently on your own tasks.

**What You’ll Do

**Your main responsibilities will include:

• Handling samples, including packing, withdrawing samples from stability chambers and sending them for analysis

• Establishing stability studies in gLIMS (Global Laboratory Information Management System)

• Handling simulations, including in-use studies, temperature cycling studies and light studies

• Coordinating sample logistics with relevant stakeholders

• Reviewing study protocols

• Participating in development projects focused on optimisation and automation of stability processes

The laboratory activities involve handling samples and supporting stability activities and do not include wet chemistry.

**Who You’ll Work With

**QC Stability and Reference Materials is a newly established department, created at the end of 2025 to strengthen the way operational stability is handled across the product portfolio, from Diabetes and Obesity to Rare Disease.

The department is responsible for planning, coordinating and executing stability activities in close collaboration with colleagues across CMC, New Product Introduction and Product Life Cycle Management. It consists of approximately 40 colleagues organised into three teams and is currently located in Bagsværd.

You will join QC Stability 2 and work alongside highly engaged and knowledgeable laboratory technicians, collaborating closely with scientists from New Product Introduction and CMC. The team is responsible for the operational handling of stability studies for new drug products in the portfolio and reference materials, with a focus on the journey from CMC to market launch.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will become part of a department with a strong quality mindset, high ambitions and a practical can-do spirit. The working environment values curiosity, ownership and teamwork, with your contribution directly supporting reliable stability data and high product quality.

The position offers a combination of laboratory and computer-based tasks, giving you variety in your daily work as well as opportunities to contribute to the continued optimisation and automation of stability processes.

**What We Offer

**At Novo, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary and Benefits: The Annual Base Salary ranges from 437,600.00 to 643,200.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

A competitive benefits package is offered, including a pension scheme (currently 13% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution) in accordance with the applicable Collective Agreement for Salaried Employees (Indutriens Funktionæroverenskomst or “IFO”).

Benefits package also include a free choice account of currently 10% and 4% holiday allowance.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to strengthen stability activities and help safeguard product quality, apply for the Laboratory Technician role by November 13th, 2026.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For questions, please reach out to Maria de los Angeles Tejada, +45-30796058.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: Electrical & Instrumentation Engineer at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
If you're energised by shaping the future of instrumentation and automation technologies and thrive in a pharmaceutical engineering environment, we'd love to hear from you!

**Who We Are

**We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

**About The Role

**We are looking for an Electrical & Instrumentation Engineer to join our Electrical & Instrumentation Department, consisting of approximately 100 engineers and specialists.

You will become part of a team of 100 engineers working across projects to design and deliver robust process control and instrumentation solutions for pharmaceutical facilities. Together, we cover everything from engineering design and specifications to testing, validation, and commissioning.

In this role, you will work closely with colleagues, vendors, and clients to ensure that electrical and instrumentation solutions meet both technical requirements and regulatory standards.

Please note that Danish language skills are required for this position.

Location Denmark - Kalundborg

Experience + 3 years

Department Electrical & Instrumentation

**How You Might Spend Your Days

**As an E&I Engineer you’ll be:

• Design and develop instrumented designs for our current & up-coming projects

• Working with vendor and client representatives in carrying out the validation activities

• Design, development, acquisition and implementation of various sensors, actuators and control solutions to meet i.e. Functional Safety, SIS and ATEX requirements

• Commissioning, testing, qualification and validation of electrical instruments solutions

• Supervising and construction coordination

• Participating in project teams, contributing to technical problem-solving and continuous improvement

**Who You Are

**We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Curious and eager to learn new skills

• Comfortable in developing close relations with stakeholders

• Taking responsibility for your tasks and approaching them proactively

• Motivated to keep deadlines and quality requirements

• Supportive and contribute to the good collaboration atmosphere

• Fostering cross organisational learning and knowledge sharing

**What You Bring To The Role

**In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• Degree in Electrical Engineering, Marine Engineering, Automation or a similar field

• + 3 years of experience within electrical, instrumentation or automation engineering

• + 2 years of hands-on experience with onsite work

• Understanding of process control systems and industrial instrumentation

• Experienced in working with industrial standards and requirements, sensors and instrumentation and PI&D’s

• Commissioning, testing or validation of technical systems

• Professional level in both English and Danish

**Why choose NNE?

**NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer **here .

****Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

****Deadline of application is 15th December 2026

**Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Søren Hedegaard on +45 3079 8206

**Please note:

**

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

**Fair hiring:

**At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

**Still searching for the right opportunity?

**If this position isn’t quite what you're looking for, but you know someone who would excel in this role, please share this job post. And don’t forget to explore our other exciting opportunities — your future role at NNE might be just around the corner! Visit our Career Site

**Senior Business Consultant, Change Management

****Join NNIT as a Senior Business Consultant in Change Management

**Transformations succeed when people are ready, equipped and motivated to adopt new ways of working. As a Senior Business Consultant in NNIT’s working group for Change & Communication Consulting, you will help clients turn transformation ambitions into sustainable business outcomes.

Change & Communication Consulting is situated within the Life Science Project Consulting (LSPC) department. We deliver standalone and complementary services to project management, supporting clients across the people side of technology, process and organizational transformation.

You’ll join a professional, collaborative department that values quality and customer focus, while also making time for team socials, and casual get-togethers.

Location: This role will be based in Copenhagen, Denmark and will require onsite/office-based presence at customer sites as well as NNIT.

****The Role:

****As a Senior Business Consultant, you will lead change management workstreams in complex transformation programs. You will advise senior stakeholders, shape change strategies, and ensure that affected employees are prepared to adopt and sustain new processes, technologies, and ways of working.

You connect change plans to business benefit realization - ensuring adoption translates into measurable business outcomes, not just completed activities.

You will work closely with project managers, client teams, and colleagues across NNIT. Depending on the engagement, you may lead the change management track, provide strategic advisory support or contribute your expertise to a broader program.

Depending on the experience you bring, the successful candidate will be offered a position as Advanced, Senior, Principal or Managing Consultant.

****Your Responsibilities:

• Develop, implement and lead change strategies, plans, and activities in complex transformation programs.

• Assess organizational readiness, stakeholder needs and project health

• Build and coach sponsor coalitions to ensure visible, active leadership of the change

• Plan and coordinate communication, training and engagement activities

• Define and track adoption and readiness metrics

• Identify risks, resistance and adoption barriers, and develop practical responses

• Facilitate workshops with teams, functions and stakeholders across cultures.

• Translate transformation objectives into clear messages and actionable change activities

• Support the development of proposals, Request for Proposals, Statements of Work, client presentations, use cases, and thought leadership.

• Mentor and support consulting talent of tomorrow in junior-senior setups

• Contribute to the continued development of change and communication methods, tools and services.

Our approach is anchored in the Prosci® framework, while remaining adaptable to each client’s context, objectives, and needs.

****Your Qualifications:

****We are looking for an experienced profile who combines strong change management expertise with sound business understanding and the ability to work confidently with senior stakeholders.

Preference will be given to candidates with experience in delivering complex change management projects within the Life Science sector. You may have worked as a Change Manager, Transformation Consultant, Senior Consultant, Project Manager, or in a similar role.

**We Expect That You Will Have:

**

• Several years of experience with change management methods, tools, and processes

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• The ability to translate complex changes into clear actions and messages

• Experience with communication planning, training, and adoption activities

• Experience integrating change plans with a project's delivery methodology (agile, hybrid or waterfall) so change activities land at the right time

• Experience with advisory, presales, proposals, or commercial support

• Strong facilitation skills and confidence working with senior stakeholders

• Confidence working independently while collaborating across multidisciplinary teams

• Excellent English skills, both written and spoken

**It Is a Distinct Advantage If You:

**

• Have experience working in or for regulated industries such as life science or finance.

• Understand digital transformation in Regulatory, Safety, Clinical, or related life science areas.

• Are a Prosci® Certified Change Practitioner.

• Have experience from consultancy or customer-facing roles

• Are curious about human behavior, learning, culture and group dynamics.

• Are a well-liked colleague.

****Your Personal Profile:

****You are motivated by helping people and organizations succeed with change. You create clarity, build trust, and help stakeholders understand what is changing, why it matters, and how to move forward.

You are proactive, structured, and able to balance strategic direction with practical execution. You communicate clearly, collaborate naturally, and take responsibility for delivering results together with your team and customers.

****Why Join NNIT:

****At NNIT, you will join a company with strong roots in IT services, digital transformation, and regulated industries. We help customers develop, implement, and manage business critical solutions with high demands for quality, security, and reliability.

**We Offer:

**

• A professional and collaborative working environment

• Opportunities to work on meaningful projects for leading customers

• Skilled colleagues with strong business and technology expertise

• Room to grow your career and develop your consulting and change management capabilities

• A culture built on responsibility, respect, and delivering quality

****About NNIT:

****NNIT is a leading provider of IT services and consulting. We deliver solutions that support digital transformation and business critical processes for customers in Denmark and internationally. Our work is guided by a strong commitment to quality, trust, and long-term customer relationships.

**Apply now

**If you are ready to help organizations succeed with change, we look forward to hearing from you.

Please submit your CV and application through our recruitment system. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

****About NNIT

****NNIT is a publicly listed company that specializes in IT solutions to life sciences internationally, and to the public and enterprise sectors in Denmark. We focus on high complexity industries and thrive in environments where regulatory demands and complexity are high. We advise on and build sustainable digital solutions that work for the patients, citizens, employees, end users or customers.

NNIT consists of group company NNIT A/S and subsidiaries SCALES, Excellis Health Solutions and SL Controls. Together, these companies employ more than 1,600 people in Europe, Asia, and USA.

We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. We actively work to eliminate bias and ensure an inclusive workplace where everyone has the right to be seen and heard as they are. We invite interested candidates to apply, no matter their background.

In the interest of fostering a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request candidates to refrain from including their pictures in their applications.

Learn more about working at NNIT

Apply now and liberate your talent!

We’re looking for a Director of Revenue Operations (RevOps) to own the commercial operating system across the group's portfolio brands of Cookie Information, Piwik PRO and Sheltr. You will lead the commercial operating plan, the shared CRM and data, attribution, forecasting, and the objective arbitration of capacity across commercial teams. This role reports to the CCO.

The Director of RevOps is the key connective role between leadership and the commercial team leads, translating strategy into an operating plan they run with, and turning their execution data into insight leadership can act on to drive predictable, efficient and sustainable revenue growth.

We are open to on-site, hybrid, and remote working within two time zones of our offices (CET).

In this role, please expect to travel up to 40% of the time.

**About Us

**Our group brings together three European software brands that help organisations earn and use data with trust: Cookie Information for consent management; Piwik PRO for privacy-by-design analytics and data activation; and Sheltr for reliably finding personal data in internal data sources.

Headquartered in Copenhagen with an office in Wrocław, our team of 180 people have been building trusted data solutions since 2011. We work with companies and marketing teams across various industries that take control of their data model, including some of the most data-sensitive clients in healthcare, finance, energy & utilities, and the public sector. We are proud that our clients rely on us to meet GDPR and EU data residency requirements across EMEA and the US, as this regulatory depth is hard to build and replicate. We believe compliance and performance are not opposites. Consented data, auditable analytics and full visibility of personal data belong to one data journey; together they form a foundation that marketing, IT, legal and the C-level can rely on.

Our journey is to move from a regulation-driven house of brands to one unified company with a clear point of view. We are creating a new category around this complete data journey, and together we are building an enterprise-ready, data-driven revenue engine led by thought leadership. Want to join us on this journey? Keep reading to find out how you can help shape this with us.

The Role

As Director of RevOps, you will own the commercial revenue engine across all three brands, ensuring alignment between strategy, processes, technology and performance. You will build and lead a multidisciplinary team and act as a strategic partner to commercial leadership, driving operational excellence and turning insights into business outcomes.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Owning the commercial operating plan, revenue forecasting and pipeline performance across the portfolio, translating business objectives into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.

• Establish a shared CRM, account universe, campaign calendar and consistent funnel definitions, ensuring reliable data, clear processes and effective collaboration across brands.

• Driving data-led improvements in conversion, deal size, customer acquisition cost, customer lifetime value and return on investment. Lead reporting and performance reviews for the CCO, CEO and Finance.

• Providing an objective, data-driven perspective on commercial capacity and investment trade-offs, escalating key decisions to the CCO when needed.

• Owning the commercial technology stack, including HubSpot, BI, forecasting, marketing automation and AI, ensuring our tools and data enable scalable growth.

• Leading BI, marketing automation, customer and partner enablement, and product marketing. Partner with Product on feature prioritisation, pricing and packaging to strengthen go-to-market effectiveness.

**About You

**You are an experienced B2B SaaS RevOps leader who understands how to build a scalable, data-driven revenue engine. You combine strong commercial and financial acumen with analytical rigour and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product and Finance.

You thrive in complex environments where you can bring structure, align competing priorities and turn data into better commercial decisions.

You bring:

• Significant experience leading Revenue Operations or owning the Sales and Marketing revenue engine in a B2B SaaS business.

• Strong commercial and financial understanding, including ARR, NRR, churn, CAC, customer lifetime value and payback.

• Deep expertise in pipeline management, funnel design, forecasting, attribution and performance optimisation.

• Advanced HubSpot expertise, including architecture, governance and process design.

• Experience with BI, marketing automation, AI and revenue technology.

• Experience leading multidisciplinary, hybrid-working teams and driving change across functions without relying solely on formal authority.

• Strong executive communication skills and the ability to influence C-level decision-making.

• Fluency in English (C2).

Nice-to-haves:

• Experience managing multi-brand or multi-product go-to-market operations on shared infrastructure.

• Experience with partner and channel models or account-based marketing.

• Familiarity with forecasting, conversation intelligence and advanced BI tools.

• Background in privacy, MarTech or analytics.

• Experience in a scale-up or PE- or VC-backed business.

• Fluency in German, French or a Nordic language.

What we offer

• Real ownership: Lead the commercial operating model across a three-brand portfolio.

• You’ll work closely with the CCO, CEO and commercial leadership to shape business priorities and decisions.

• You get to build shared systems, processes and insights that enable more effective and scalable commercial execution.

• A chance to make an impact: Strengthen how three growing SaaS brands plan, execute and scale their commercial growth through better data, processes and insights.

• Professional development budget, health insurance, and other benefits.

• A positive, informal workplace.

Application process

We’re looking to fill the position as soon as possible and will be inviting candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to send your application today.

This is what our recruitment process looks like:

• A brief screening call with our Talent Partner (online, approx. 30 mins)

• An in-depth interview with the hiring manager and a member of the team

• Interview with a key stakeholder including a live case

• A final interview with our CCO

This process is subject to change. All applicants who progress to the screening call will be informed of the full process as some stages may be combined and/or in person.

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Cookie Information & Piwik PRO we value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability. We recognise that certain groups are underrepresented in the tech industry, and we encourage everyone to apply and help us shape a more inclusive workspace.

**Driving client strategy, commercial activities and a team of specialists

**As a Director in our programmatic team, you will take ownership of media planning and strategy on some of our largest clients. You will actively drive the commercial growth of our department while shaping our programmatic offering. Joining a collaborative team of 10 specialists, you will also expand your leadership skills by taking on the day-to-day management of a couple of our specialists in Aarhus.

**Join our programmatic team

We are a tight knit team and we are regularly doing social events, both as a whole team across offices and as teams in each of the two locations.

**Shape the role with your expertise

**We are looking for a professional who can combine a deep specialist knowledge with an urge to drive cutting edge media strategy with a consultative mindset. You are ready to lead client relationships, drive complex engagements, and play an active role in strengthening our team and commercial offering.

To the role you will bring:

• Programmatic experience: You bring approximately 5 years of solid experience working with programmatic advertising spanning media planning, ad ops, execution in various ad-tech platforms (GMP experience preferred) and commercial pitching.

• Cross-channel and -media: You have experience across different platforms and channels within digital advertising. Experience with traditional offline media is considered a plus.

• Client management: You have experience in a client-facing role and recognise the absolute importance of cultivating strong, trusted client relations.

• Team mindset: You are a collaborative team player with high ambitions for both your personal development and the growth of the team around you.

**What It's Like Working At S360

**At s360, you will be part of a Marketing and AI consultancy, working alongside more than 330 skilled colleagues across 10 offices in 8 countries. While our shared mission is to help brands and retailers grow, we are equally committed to fostering a strong culture, defined by collaboration, drive, and continuous development. We believe that our culture and ways of working are key to delivering long-term, meaningful results.

As a part of our team, you can look forward to:

• Skilled colleagues: Collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry and be part of an ambitious team with deep expertise across all key digital disciplines.

• Top-tier clients: Work with some of the biggest brands in the world on solving their most complex and interesting commercial problems.

• Growth journey: Join one of the fastest-growing marketing and AI consultancies in Europe with the ambition of becoming the best in the world.

• International environment: With 10 offices across 8 countries, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with people from diverse cultures around the world.

• Career acceleration: Get individual career plans to influence your own professional path and contribute to shaping the company’s future.

• Continuous development: A learning culture where people strive to become 1% better every day, supported by advanced training and knowledge sharing.

**We’d love to hear from you

**Does this sound like the right fit for you? Then don’t hesitate to apply or reach out to Senior Director & Head of Mads Hantho at +45 30911567 or mhh@s360digital.com.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and hire as soon as the right candidate is found, so please send your CV and application as soon as possible. All inquiries are treated confidentially.

s360 is a marketing and AI consultancy. We help brands and retailers achieve measurable results with AI, proprietary technology, and over a decade of industry experience.

We're certified partners of Anthropic, Google, Meta, and Smartly, among others. As an end-to-end partner, we work with clients on strategy, execution, and forward deployment across brand, media, creative, and AI. Our specialists and engineers work from offices across Europe, close to the clients we serve.

**The Impact You'll Make

**As our Program Manager, Incubation Data Center (m/f/d), you will play a key role in driving innovation within the Data Center Business Unit at Danfoss Power Solutions, preferably based in Copenhagen, Denmark. You'll lead local and global cross-functional project teams from initiation and planning through execution, monitoring, control and closure, ensuring successful delivery of the agreed business case. You'll take ownership of low- to medium-risk programs across new product development (NPD), product-related initiatives, large-scale new business onboarding and cost-out/value analysis and value engineering (VA/VE) projects.

Your impact will be measured by successful project delivery, transparent reporting to leadership and timely corrective action. You'll also help develop and continuously improve processes, guidelines and tools for new product development, bringing teams together and driving accountability in a matrix organization.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Plan and lead medium-complexity programs: build program management plans, cross-functionally informed work breakdown structures (WBS) and schedules; align priorities, staffing, requirements and a robust Statement of Work (SoW) before baseline; ensure the team understands contractual commitments and baseline change control.

• Drive disciplined execution and delivery: manage scope and scope changes, run regular team meetings, follow through on commitments and action items, and assess program health through earned-value measures (CPI/SPI), quality, technical performance, Focus 5 and delivery indicators. Identify and quantify risks and opportunities, implement mitigation plans and initiate corrective actions when needed.

• Own the business case and customer outcomes: understand the strategic product roadmap and how the organization develops and launches products; validate customer needs and pain points with relevant stakeholders, account for product and development requirements, and ensure program scope and execution support successful Entry-Into-Service (EIS). Assess changes against business-case impact and guide team decisions accordingly.

• Lead through collaboration and communication: build relationships with cross-functional leaders and key customers, communicate progress and issues promptly and transparently to internal and external leadership, and influence international or cross-divisional teams without relying on formal authority. Inspire accountability, recognize strengths and development needs, and mentor and coach team members.

• Improve how change is delivered: develop and refine NPD processes and tools, apply organizational change-management principles, and coordinate communication, training, feedback and mitigation. Monitor change effectiveness, navigate cultural diversity and organizational dynamics, and adapt plans and resources to address obstacles.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Master’s degree in Business or a technical field (required).

• At least five years of project management or engineering experience (required); Program Management Professional certification is preferred.

• Strong command of project and program management methods and tools, with consistent follow-up, structured planning, performance monitoring, risk management and timely corrective action.

• Ability to independently lead cross-divisional and international teams in a matrix environment, build strong networks, empower colleagues through delegation and create commitment through open, constructive dialogue.

• Sound judgment in complex situations: anticipate and overcome roadblocks, evaluate alternative solutions, communicate appropriately across stakeholders and adapt effectively to organizational change and cultural differences.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

jobs.occupation: Global Internal Communication & Engagement Specialist - Shape the way we connect and communicate
jobs.description:
Would you like the freedom to shape how colleagues across countries, functions and teams connect with the bigger picture? Do you love finding the story behind the message and turning complex topics into communication people actually want to read?

Help shape the future of internal communication at ABENA – starting with the platform that brings us together.

At ABENA, we are strengthening our People & Culture agenda, with an ambition to create an even better employee experience across our organization. Our focus on job satisfaction, engagement and a strong sense of belonging also means continuously developing how we connect and communicate with our colleagues.

We are looking to rethink our internal communication platform and move toward a modern Microsoft 365 environment. You will play a central role i rethinking how colleagues across countries, functions and teams find information, share stories and connect with the bigger picture through our future internal communication platform.

As our new Global Internal Communication & Engagement Specialist, you will step into a newly created role with considerable freedom to shape both the role and how we communicate across ABENA. If you see a better way to communicate, we want to hear it. You will create content yourself, turn business priorities and leadership messages into clear and engaging communication, and find stories worth sharing across functions and countries.

The aim is to do more than keep people informed: bring colleagues closer to our business, create engagement and strengthen the feeling of being part of one ABENA.

Your key responsibilities will include

• Create engaging internal content - write and shape global news, leadership communication, town hall content and stories that engages all employees.

• Help shape our future digital workplace – bring the business and communication perspective as we rethink our internal communication platform and move toward a modern Microsoft 365 environment.

• Own and set direction for how we communicate internally – help define principles, formats and communication flows, including what we communicate, where and how.

• Bring stories to life across ABENA – spot good stories across countries and functions, work with local editors and turn input into communication people want to read.

• Guide and spar with colleagues responsible for local communication, helping them apply best practices, turn local input into engaging content, and creating greater consistency between global and local communication.

• Keep communication relevant and moving – plan communication activities and editorial calendars, follow up on execution and use feedback and insights to continuously improve how we communicate.

What we are looking for:

• 3–5 years of experience in internal, corporate or organizational communication, ideally from an international organization with multiple countries and stakeholders.

• A digitally curious and tech-savvy communicator with a good understanding of internal communication and engagement platforms and their possibilities. Experience with SharePoint, Microsoft 365, or similar environments is a strong advantage.

• A strong writer and content creator who knows how to find the story, sharpen the message and adapt communication to different audiences and channels.

• Experience turning leadership decisions, organizational changes and complex topics into communication that is simple, relevant and easy to understand.

• The confidence to set direction and create structure – you are comfortable establishing formats, guidelines and ways of working and helping others apply them consistently.

• A hands-on and outgoing approach – you enjoy reaching out across the organization, building relationships and getting things from idea to finished communication, while keeping track of many moving parts.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Danish and English.

Your Team, Our Culture and Values

You will join our Group HR team, working alongside experienced HR specialists and generalists who work closely together, share ideas, and use each other’s different perspectives and expertise. Even when things are busy, we make room for laughter and a good atmosphere. We value collaboration and openness. For us, it is important that we support one another, and that it is genuinely enjoyable to come to work. Creating and maintaining a positive atmosphere and a great team spirit is something we are all responsible for.

Department: Product

**Description

**At Factbird, we're redefining how manufacturing runs. By combining hardware, firmware, cloud, and AI, we turn raw production data into real, measurable impact on factory floors around the world. This is a product built by and for people who understand what happens on the shop floor. We’re on a mission to make it easier and faster for manufacturers to work smarter to increase productivity and eliminate waste.

For this mission we're building fast, scaling with purpose, and solving problems that matter. Now, we're looking for an addition to our product management team, who want to bring our product into the future by expanding upon how we create real value on the factory floor.

The position product management plays at Factbird is both high-impact and also hands-on. As a product manager here, you’ll set direction, own the roadmap, and drive execution from idea to launch and beyond. You’ll play a key role in shaping how our platform scales and how our customers succeed.

**

About the role

**You’ll work closely with a dedicated development team and your peer product leaders, and you report to the Director of Product.

Production Insights: As a key platform application the candidate requires a strong PM backbone with a focus on having built products that communicate complex datasets and provide actionable insights to different user groups. To succeed in this role, previous experience from manufacturing industries is a key differentiator for us. Whether you have stood on that shopfloor and owned its numbers yourself or have worked for manufacturing and know exactly what "real value" means to the people running a production line – we take “knowing our customers” very serious for this particular position.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Turn strategy into shipped products: Define roadmaps, prioritize ruthlessly, and work closely with stakeholders to ensure we solve the biggest problems our customers are facing.

• Lead across disciplines: Act as the glue between product, firmware, cloud, UX, and business stakeholders - making sure everyone is aligned, focused, and moving fast.

• Identify signals in noise: Clarify customer needs, outline their jobs to be done and translate findings into clear and concise user stories.

• Spearhead continuous discovery: Build and maintain strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders to gather key insights.

• Launch, learn, iterate: Drive product launches, gather customer feedback, and continuously evolve features based on real-world usage.

• Own performance & outcomes: Define and track key performance metrics aligned with product objectives.

**About you

**You have experienced first-hand how a shop floor is operated to ensure targets are met and continuous improvements are realized. You thrive in environments where ownership is high, pace is fast, and impact is visible. You're comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and love turning complexity into clarity, because you've had to do exactly that on a production floor before.

You are curious about technology and are keen to figure out what it enables for people who live and breathe shop floor realities every day. You care deeply about understanding the underlying problem before working on a solution. You want to build products that drive real value, something customers depend on, not just move on to the next shiny thing.

**

Requirements**

• Solid Product Management Experience: You are well-versed in product management frameworks and agile processes and can bring them into play with a practical approach, leveraging frameworks where they create clarity, structure, and speed.

• You've worked hands-on on the shopfloor for a while. You've been accountable for ensuring performance meets expectations by collaborating with the likes of operators, process engineers, continuous improvement leads, and plant or operations managers. This operational depth is what lets you translate real production pain into product decisions, and it is a hard requirement for this specific role — without it, the rest of the role is very difficult to do well. Our products play an essential role in manufacturing operations, and your experience within this field is essential.

• A continuous discovery mindset: You talk to customers constantly, map their jobs to be done, and identify commonalities. You're comfortable sitting with ambiguity until the real problem surfaces.

• Strong data and analytics instinct: Comfortable working with data and understanding how to turn analysis into concrete actions.

• A natural communicator: You speak the language of engineers, designers, operators, and leadership alike, adapting how you communicate to whoever's in the room.

• Driving teams: Proven ability to set and agree direction and goals with R&D teams, driving the team and getting to results in a manner where the team feels proud of the outcome.

**Why Factbird?

**People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here's what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn’t one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We’ll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we’ll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide kickoffs & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what’s next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We’re proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

**We’d love to hear from you

**If this role feels like a match, we’d be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out to Khristel, our Global Talent Acquisition & People Operations Lead at **khma@factbird.com

**_At Factbird, we believe that great work starts with people feeling respected, valued, and included. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

Copenhagen, Denmark

_Want to put your financial markets expertise to work across exchanges, market data providers and multiple asset classes? Join Saxo’s Market Data & Exchange Relations team and take ownership in an area connecting markets, technology and commercial relationships.

_**About The Role

**This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of financial markets, market data, exchanges and technology in an international environment. You will collaborate with exchanges, market data providers and colleagues across Saxo, helping ensure that the data supporting our trading platforms and internal systems is managed effectively.

The Market Data & Exchange Relations team manages licensing and relationships with the external vendors and exchanges that provide market data to Saxo's trading platforms and internal systems.

Depending on your experience, you may bring established market data expertise to the team or relevant experience from another part of the financial sector and an interest in developing further within market data and exchange relations.

You will gain broad exposure to the financial markets value chain and work across multiple asset classes, including equities, futures, options and bonds.

The position involves collaboration across Saxo's international organisation, including commercial, operational, technology, finance and other specialist teams. You will also engage directly with exchanges and external data providers.

**Your Responsibilities

**Your responsibilities will include a combination of contract management, operational and commercial, including:

• Managing and maintaining relationships with market data vendors and exchanges, including licensing requirements and usage rights

• Negotiating, reviewing and maintaining market data licensing and vendor agreements, including commercial terms, permitted use and redistribution rights

• Acting as a point of contact for exchanges, vendors and other external partners

• Working with internal teams on billing, budgeting and reporting

• Monitoring and analysing market data usage, licensing permissions, entitlements and reporting obligations

• Supporting appropriate and compliant use of licensed market data across the organisation, in line with exchange and vendor licensing terms

• Providing market data licensing expertise and guidance to internal projects, new products and initiatives

• Managing day-to-day enquiries from internal and external stakeholders

• Supporting the ongoing development of processes and controls within the Market Data & Exchange Relations area

The scope and level of ownership can be adapted to your experience.

**Your profile

**We are interested in candidates with experience from market data, financial markets, exchanges, trading, financial services or a related field.

You may already be an experienced market data professional, or you may have developed relevant knowledge in another area of the financial sector and see market data as your next specialisation.

**We Expect That You

**

• Have relevant professional experience within financial services, market data or a related environment

• Have an interest in financial markets and how data supports trading and investment services

• Are comfortable working with contracts, data, processes and multiple stakeholders

• Take a structured and reliable approach to your work and can manage competing priorities

• Communicate effectively with both specialist and non-specialist stakeholders

• Are comfortable working with Excel, datasets and presentation tools and can learn new systems

• Can work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment

• Are comfortable working in English in an international organisation

Experience working directly with market data vendors, stock exchanges, market data licensing, usage rights, redistribution, entitlements, reporting obligations or market data agreements would be valuable, but candidates with transferable experience from the wider financial sector are also encouraged to apply.

**An international role with broad market exposure

**This position provides an opportunity to develop a detailed understanding of how financial-market data moves from exchanges and providers into the systems and services used by investors and market participants.

You will work with colleagues and external partners across markets and functions, giving you exposure to both the commercial and operational aspects of market data.

Whether you bring several years of specialist experience or are looking to broaden your financial-markets expertise, the role offers the opportunity to take meaningful ownership while continuing to develop your knowledge.

The position is based at Saxo Bank's headquarters in Denmark.

**We get curious people invested in the world

**When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

**How To Apply

**Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

Leading a team of Architects and Innovation Engineers, you will define and drive the technology roadmap for next-generation Controllers, Displays, Remote Controls, and Joysticks, helping create the technologies that will power safer, more productive, connected, and increasingly autonomous machines.

**

At Original Coffee, we are looking for an analytical and structured Production & Supply Planner to strengthen our production planning across our bakery and coffee roastery.

This is a newly created position where you will have the opportunity to shape processes, improve efficiency, and ensure production aligns with demand while keeping inventory, costs, and resources under control.

You will work closely with our Production, Operations, Wholesale, and Finance teams, turning data and insights into practical improvements.

About us

Original Coffee (OC) is a growing company with 22 coffee shops around Copenhagen. We invite our guests to pause, refocus, and connect—both with themselves and with others. From the moment they walk through our doors, our mission is to create a memorable experience: freshly baked goods from our own bakery, exceptional coffee from our own roastery, and outstanding service. Together, that’s what we call the OC experience!

In OC it all starts with people – our guests, our team, and our partners. We believe that putting people first creates the foundation for strong communities, great experiences, and coffee worth coming back for!

Your responsibilities

As our Production & Supply Planner, you will help build a structured, data-driven approach to production planning.

• Production planning: Develop and maintain production plans based on demand, sales, seasonality, and capacity.

• Forecasting: Analyze data and forecast future production needs.

• Inventory management: Monitor stock and optimize inventory.

• Cost calculations: Calculate and maintain accurate product costs in collaboration with our production and Finance.

• Take ownership, work independently, and enjoy collaborating across teams.

At Original Coffee, you'll join a passionate team dedicated to great coffee, quality products, and memorable experiences.

• Close collaboration with dedicated colleagues across our bakery, roastery, and HQ.

Sounds like something for you?

Join Deloitte’s Nordic Sales Excellence Team to develop compelling pricing strategies and commercial solutions that deliver value for clients and strengthen profitability. This is an exciting opportunity to help increase the win rate and shape commercial decisions for Deloitte’s largest and most important deals.

About us

With more than 8,000 employees, Deloitte is one of the largest professional services firms across the Nordics. We help clients navigate complex business and technology transformations by combining deep industry expertise with leading capabilities in Audit, Tax, Advisory, and Consulting.

Join our diverse Nordic Technology & Transformation Sales Excellence team and help shape Deloitte’s most strategic pursuits. The team helps win deals and improve profitability through compelling pricing and commercial propositions for our clients. We provide expert advice on all commercial aspects of client proposals, focusing primarily on higher-value, more complex deals and Deloitte’s most important Nordic clients.

This role can be placed either in Copenhagen, Denmark or in Oslo, Norway.

What will be your role?

We aim to become the largest professional services firm in the Nordics by continuously innovating, evolving and adapting to meet clients’ needs. To achieve this, we need to strengthen our commercial expertise to support our most complex deals, to our most important clients. You will play a key role in our Nordic Sales Excellence team, and your worksite is therefore flexible within the Nordics.

As our Commercial and Pricing Specialist, your role will be to structure and shape commercial solutions to respond to our client’s requirements and challenges and to help win business and improve profitability. You will work closely with the rest of the Nordic Sales Excellence Team and the stakeholders for our major Nordic accounts to shape commercial arrangements.

The core responsibilities of your role include:

• Shape commercial solutions for complex opportunities, bringing together clients’ needs, pricing options and commercial considerations into compelling proposals

• Develop pricing strategies and structures that demonstrate value to clients and improve our ability to win work

• Build and challenge deal economics through financial modelling, testing margins, assumptions, pricing scenarios and commercial risks

• Partner with proposal teams to design and implement commercial strategies that grow revenue and strengthen profitability

• Advance value-based pricing by helping pursuit teams identify and quantify expected clients’ outcomes, then translate them into appropriate pricing models

• Support proposals and negotiations by clearly articulating the pricing structure and commercial assumptions, and advising on terms and trade-offs

• Build commercial capability across the Nordics through practical guidance, training, knowledge sharing and improvements to the various tools and ways of working

Who are we looking for?

You are a commercially minded professional with strong analytical and modelling skills, together with good business acumen. We are looking for a team player with a collegiate style who enjoys working, collaborating and having fun with team-mates.

We imagine that you have:

• A minimum of 5 years’ experience in pricing, commercial finance, deal shaping or a related commercial role; professional-services experience is an advantage

• A strong financial modelling and Excel skills, with the ability to turn analysis into clear recommendations

• Experience with leveraging AI applications in commercial work, with the judgement to evaluate outputs

• Confidence working with senior stakeholders and collaborating across functions and countries

• Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain pricing choices and commercial terms

• It would be desirable, but not essential, to have professional services experience and insights, ideally having worked within a consulting or professional service organisation

• Flexibility to meet peaks of work inherent in the cycle of a deal

• Proficient in written and spoken English. Knowledge of another Scandinavian language is a benefit

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

What impact will your role make?

Every day, your work will make an impact that matters, while you thrive in a dynamic culture of inclusion, collaboration and high performance. We do not just aspire to make solutions. We wish to create an impact that makes a positive and crucial difference for the people around us, our clients and our society. Deloitte is where you’ll find unlimited opportunities to succeed and realize your full potential.

Do you want to be a part of our team?

Please submit your CV and answer a few questions about your experience. We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the position once the right candidate has been identified.

Application deadline is December 1, 2026.

Please do not hesitate to contact Inu Agarwal at inuagarwal@deloitte.no if you have any questions about the position.

We look forward to connecting with you!

From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

People & Organization

**Make an impact where international mobility meets people

**Are you experienced in global mobility and international P&O, and do you enjoy solving complex cross-border employment challenges while supporting people and the business?

At Xellia, we are looking for a Global Mobility Expert & P&O Consultant to ensure compliant, people-focused international mobility arrangements and provide practical P&O consultancy across the hire-to-retire employee lifecycle at our Copenhagen Site and headquarters.

This is an opportunity to combine specialist global mobility knowledge with broad, hands-on P&O support in an international organisation where your work makes a visible difference to employees and managers.

**Working across borders — and close to the business

**You will join People & Organisation (P&O), based in Copenhagen, reporting to the Director, Global Employee Relations and P&O Copenhagen.

Your everyday work combines international mobility cases, ongoing support for cross-border EU commuters and practical P&O consultancy across the employee lifecycle. You will work with employees, managers, Payroll, P&O colleagues and external specialists across countries, balancing accurate compliance with responsive, people-focused service.

**Own it — global mobility and hire-to-retire P&O support

**You will coordinate complex international employment arrangements while supporting managers and employees with practical P&O advice and consistent hire-to-retire processes at Copenhagen Site and HQ.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Global mobility: Own and coordinate international transfers, assignments, relocations, EU cross-border commuters and other cross-border employment arrangements, ensuring accurate and compliant case handling.

• Specialist advice: Be a trusted mobility advisor to managers, employees and P&O, coordinating immigration, work and residence permits, visas, international employment requirements, taxation and social security with external specialists.

• Compliance and risk: Coordinate A1 certificates, documentation and renewals, support compliant cross-border remote working arrangements, and identify and proactively manage immigration, employment, tax and social security risks.

• Cross-border payroll: Coordinate split payroll, tax adjustments, social security contributions and information exchange with Payroll and external providers; payroll processing remains with the relevant providers.

• Mobility case management and employee service: Manage case timelines, records, advisers and external providers, ensuring employees on international assignments and EU commuters receive timely, reliable ongoing support.

• Hire-to-retire P&O consultancy: Provide practical advice and operational support to managers and employees at Copenhagen Site and HQ throughout the employee lifecycle, ensuring consistent P&O processes and responsive handling of day-to-day P&O matters.

• Organisational change and continuous improvement among other P&O tasks: Support organisational changes and help implement updated P&O processes, guidelines and new ways of working.

Success in this role means international transfers and EU commuter arrangements are handled accurately and on time; cross-border payroll, permits and renewals are well coordinated; and Copenhagen Site and HQ receive consistent, practical support across hire-to-retire P&O processes and employee relations.

**Do you have what it takes?

**We expect you to bring:

• A relevant educational background in HR, Business Administration or a related field.

• Approximately 5–10 years of relevant experience in global/EU mobility, international P&O, immigration or a related specialist area.

• Solid knowledge of immigration, cross-border taxation, social security and international employment matters.

• Experience coordinating international payroll arrangements and external providers.

• Good understanding of Danish employment legislation, employee relations and P&O processes, including the ability to provide practical P&O advice.

• Fluency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

Experience with cross-border EU commuters and cooperation with external immigration, tax or relocation advisers will be an advantage.

You take accountability for your work, combine attention to detail with a practical mindset and enjoy finding solutions to complex challenges. You build trust across cultures and functions, communicate clearly and understand the importance of both compliance and the employee experience.

**A word from our team

**“Behind every international move or cross-border employment arrangement are people with individual needs and expectations. We are looking for someone who understands both the human and business perspectives, takes ownership, and makes complex matters simple — ensuring our people feel supported, wherever they work.”

— Kira Mondrup, Director, Global Employee Relations and P&O Copenhagen

**What's in it for you?

**

• Xellia isn't for all: There's no rigid hierarchy here, and no one will micromanage you. You're trusted and expected to take real responsibility, perform at a high level, and learn fast. In return, you get the opportunity to shape how things are done, influence decisions, and make a visible impact.

• Make things happen: You'll step into an organization in motion, with clear direction and ambitious goals. Here, you can grow fast, take on more than a fixed role, and shape what's next alongside people who want to win.

**Are you interested?

**We are looking to fill this position as soon as possible. Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply at your earliest convenience.

**We are your people

**Everything we do connects to our purpose to save lives. Every day, every task we do plays a part in one of the biggest battles of our time: fighting the most powerful bacteria on the planet. But at Xellia, it's not just about what we do - it's about how we do it and who we do it with. We work side by side, eye to eye, and heart to heart across functions and sites, building strong relationships and making an impact. We run on curiosity, trust, and honest conversations. We speak up and share what we know. It's not just where you want to go. It's who you get there with. At Xellia, we're your people.

Xellia is owned by Novo Holdings A/S, headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, and operates globally.

Xellia Pharmaceuticals is the global leader in fermentation-based, non-beta-lactam anti-infectives, supplying Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) and Finished Dosage Forms (FDFs) to over 500 pharmaceutical companies across 80 countries.

Recognized by the World Health Organization and the European Union for our critical medicines, we play a vital role in combating severe infections and antimicrobial resistance. Headquartered in Denmark, we operate manufacturing sites in Copenhagen, Denmark; Budapest, Hungary; and Taizhou, China, with R&D and commercial operations in seven additional locations globally. As the only European manufacturer of several key anti-infectives and with a heritage spanning over 120 years, we are driven by purpose and progress.

With more than 1100 employees, our impact starts from within. We offer a workplace where ideas, curiosity, and initiative thrive, and where your role evolves with your ambition. Instead of rigid structures, we provide real responsibility, freedom to explore, and support to grow. We are undergoing a strategic transformation with a clear ambition: to double the size of the business over the next five years. A significant share of this growth will come from a segment we have not historically approached systematically: the many small and medium-sized customers who currently buy on a transactional basis. This is why we are creating this role.

The role

As Head of Transactional Business, you will have full commercial responsibility for DBI’s global transactional business – revenue, margin and growth across all small and medium-sized customers. This is a business-building role: our channels are at different stages of maturity, and your task will be to structure, professionalise and scale them. You will work through two channels: our webshop and a dealer and distributor network that needs to expand. At the same time, you will transform customer service from a reactive function into a proactive, sales-driving team. As a member of the management team, you will contribute to DBI’s overall strategic direction – not just your own area.

Your responsibilities

• Commercial ownership. Full responsibility for sales, budgets and forecasts for the small and medium-sized customer segment. You set targets, track progress and deliver results.

• E-commerce. End-to-end ownership of the webshop – product range, pricing, conversion, customer journey and digital self-service experience. You run it as a business, not as an IT project.

• Marketplaces. We want to increase our visibility on marketplaces such as Amazon and Alibaba.

• EDI and digital integration. Expand EDI connections with small and medium-sized customers to create a seamless, scalable order flow in collaboration with our operations and IT teams.

• Distribution channels. Select, onboard, negotiate contracts with and manage the performance of distributors – supported by a clear channel strategy that avoids conflict with our direct business.

• Customer service-led outbound sales. Build a culture and operating model in which customer service actively drives sales through upselling, repeat-purchase cycles, reactivating dormant customers and qualifying leads.

• People leadership. Lead the team supporting our transactional channels, providing visible, clear leadership and well-defined decision-making responsibilities.

• Management team. Play an active role in DBI’s management team and share responsibility for delivering our ambition to double the size of the business.

Your profile

Essential experience

• Proven experience in driving e-commerce commercially – ideally in B2B – with responsibility for revenue and conversion, not just the platform.

• Experience in building and developing distribution channels: identifying, negotiating with and managing distributors or dealers.

• Experience in customer service-led outbound sales – you have personally helped transform a service team from reactive to proactive.

• Leadership experience with direct people management responsibility, ideally at management team level.

Skills and personal qualities

• This is a highly hands-on role with a small team, so you must enjoy working both strategically and at a very practical, operational level.

• You are data-driven and take a structured approach to KPIs, pipeline management and channel economics.

• You make decisions – even when information is incomplete – and communicate them in a way others can understand and act on.

• You are equally comfortable in an industrial manufacturing environment and working with a digital commercial agenda.

• You work across borders and cultures and understand how a global footprint shapes sales.

• You are fluent in spoken and written English.

What we offer

• A newly created role with a genuine mandate to shape an entire business area.

• A seat on the management team, with direct access to the Managing Director and a short path to decisions.

• A family-owned company with long-standing customer relationships, high quality standards and an ambitious growth plan.

• A competitive employment package reflecting the responsibilities of the role.

How to apply

Apply on www.dbiplastics.com by 16 November 2026. We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply early.

jobs.occupation: Laboratory Technician with Upstream/Recovery Process Experience
jobs.description:
**Your impact begins here

**Bring your practical laboratory skills into a role where your work will help develop, optimise and troubleshoot API processes. As a Laboratory Technician, you will support recovery activities connected to our yeast fermentation platform, working hands-on with chromatography, filtration and centrifugation. Your attention to detail and curiosity will help us run reliable experiments, improve our processes and address challenges that arise in production.

**What You'll Bring

**You enjoy practical laboratory work and bring a structured approach to experiments, equipment and data. You can take ownership of your tasks while working closely with colleagues in a changing laboratory environment.

**To Succeed In This Role, We Expect You To

**

• Hold a qualification as a laboratory technician, process technologist or in a related discipline.

• Have practical experience with upstream or downstream processes.

• Bring hands-on laboratory experience for recovery processes, ideally including fermentation.

• Work with attention to detail, both independently and as part of a team.

• Take initiative, identify what needs to be done and follow tasks through to completion.

• Communicate confidently in English, the primary working language of the team.

You will also benefit from being curious and open to learning, particularly as tasks and priorities can change. Strong collaboration and a service-oriented approach will help you build effective working relationships across the team.

**What You'll Do

**Your work will centre on recovery processes and the practical laboratory activities needed to develop and optimise them. You will:

• Perform recovery activities using laboratory processes and equipment including chromatography (ÄKTA), filtration and centrifugation.

• Conduct experiments and analyse the resulting data.

• Prepare laboratory equipment and materials and help keep them ready for reliable use.

• Support the development and optimisation of recovery processes within the yeast fermentation platform.

• Help troubleshoot and resolve production process challenges through laboratory-scale work.

• Carry out your work in accordance with safety requirements and good laboratory practice.

**Who You'll Work With

**You will join API MSAT Process Upstream 2, a team working at the interface between development and production. The team currently consists of 11 scientists and specialists and seven laboratory technicians.

Together, the team develops and optimises API processes at laboratory scale, conducts experiments, tests and measurements, and supports the troubleshooting of production process challenges. Your laboratory environment will include fermentation, chromatography using ÄKTA systems, filtration and centrifugation.

You will work closely with colleagues who combine scientific and practical laboratory expertise, contributing your own hands-on perspective while learning from others. The team also shares responsibility for maintaining its laboratories and keeping equipment in reliable working condition.

**What You Can Expect Here

**At Novo Nordisk, you will have the opportunity to work hands-on with advanced laboratory technologies while contributing to the development and optimisation of processes that support our work in medicines. You will be part of an environment where curiosity, continuous improvement and collaboration are important to how the team approaches its work.

The role gives you opportunities to develop your laboratory capabilities while taking ownership of practical activities and contributing to solving real process challenges.

**What We Offer

**Salary and Benefits: The Annual Base Salary for a Laboratory Technician ranges from DKK 437,600-643,200, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

A competitive benefits package is offered, including a pension scheme (currently 13% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution) in accordance with the applicable Collective Agreement for Salaried Employees (Indutriens Funktionæroverenskomst or “IFO”).

Benefits package also include a free choice account of currently 10% and 4% holiday allowance.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today.

If you are ready to bring your laboratory experience to recovery processes and contribute to developing and optimising our work in Bagsværd, apply for the Laboratory Technician with Upstream/Recovery Process Experience role by 18 November 2026.

For further information, please contact Hiring Manager Claus Juul-Mortensen on +45 30759732.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.
